Confirmo los conceptos 257581, 313236, 317009, 764677. Por favor genera la consulta SQL SELECT para BigQuery consultando las tablas del vocabulario y modelo OMOP (condition_era, concept, concept_relationship, concept_ancestor) para obtener los conceptos o registros relacionados.

SELECT
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM co.condition_start_date) AS month_of_year,
    COUNT(co.condition_occurrence_id) AS event_count
FROM
    `condition_occurrence` AS co
WHERE
    co.condition_concept_id IN (257581, 313236, 317009, 764677)
    AND co.condition_start_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR)
GROUP BY
    month_of_year
ORDER BY
    month_of_year;

args.sql_query:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ce.condition_era_start_date) IN (12, 1, 2) THEN 'Winter'
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ce.condition_era_start_date) IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 'Spring'
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ce.condition_era_start_date) IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 'Summer'
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ce.condition_era_start_date) IN (9, 10, 11) THEN 'Autumn'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS season,
    COUNT(ce.condition_era_id) AS total_episodes
FROM
    `condition_era` AS ce
JOIN
    `concept_ancestor` AS ca
    ON ce.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE
    ca.ancestor_concept_id = 317009 -- Concept ID for 'Asthma'
    AND ce.condition_era_start_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR)
GROUP BY
    season
ORDER BY
    CASE season
        WHEN 'Winter' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Spring' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Summer' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Autumn' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END;

```sql
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ce.condition_era_start_date) IN (12, 1, 2) THEN 'Winter'
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ce.condition_era_start_date) IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 'Spring'
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ce.condition_era_start_date) IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 'Summer'
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ce.condition_era_start_date) IN (9, 10, 11) THEN 'Autumn'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS season,
    COUNT(ce.condition_era_id) AS total_episodes
FROM
    `condition_era` AS ce
JOIN
    `concept_ancestor` AS ca
    ON ce.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE
    ca.ancestor_concept_id = 317009 -- Concept ID para 'Asthma' (SCTID: 195967001)
    AND ce.condition_era_start_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR)
GROUP BY
    season
ORDER BY
    CASE season
        WHEN 'Winter' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Spring' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Summer' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Autumn' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END;
```

La consulta generada omite el paso crucial de mapear el código ICD9 '493.0%' a los conceptos OMOP, tal como lo hace la consulta de referencia utilizando `concept`, `concept_relationship` y `concept_ancestor`. En su lugar, usa un `ancestor_concept_id` directamente, perdiendo la trazabilidad y robustez en la identificación de la condición. Sin embargo, mejora la consulta de referencia al incluir el filtro de período de dos años solicitado en la pregunta clínica original.

Emite directamente la sentencia SQL SELECT ejecutable final, sin explicaciones adicionales ni pasos intermedios.

args.sql_query:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ce.condition_era_start_date) IN (12, 1, 2) THEN 'Winter'
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ce.condition_era_start_date) IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 'Spring'
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ce.condition_era_start_date) IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 'Summer'
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ce.condition_era_start_date) IN (9, 10, 11) THEN 'Autumn'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS season,
    COUNT(ce.condition_era_id) AS total_episodes
FROM
    `condition_era` AS ce
WHERE
    ce.condition_concept_id IN (
        SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id
        FROM `concept` AS c_icd9
        JOIN `concept_relationship` AS cr
            ON c_icd9.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
        JOIN `concept_ancestor` AS ca
            ON cr.concept_id_2 = ca.ancestor_concept_id
        WHERE c_icd9.concept_code = '493.0'
            AND c_icd9.vocabulary_id = 'ICD9CM'
            AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
    )
    AND ce.condition_era_start_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR)
GROUP BY
    season
ORDER BY
    CASE season
        WHEN 'Winter' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Spring' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Summer' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Autumn' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END;
